Create your character, roll a d20, and let the AI Game Master shape your adventure. Every success or failure branches the story in unique ways — no fixed paths, just evolving tales you live through. Build heroes, explore worlds, and experience narrative-driven RPGs reimagined for mobile.

records.name: XTour AI
records.tagline: Explore the world with xTour AI
records.description: xTour AI 🌍 is your smart travel companion, designed to make exploring the world easier and more fun. Ask questions about destinations, local culture, cuisine, and safaris, and get instant, dynamic answers. Whether you’re planning a trip or just curious, xTour AI helps you discover, learn, and experience travel like never before — all in one place, in English or Swahili.

records.name: Nakay Flow
records.tagline: Visualize, organize your travel.
records.description: Tired of your travel memories being scattered? Nakay Flow brings them into a single, visual timeline. What makes us different is our "flow" view, turning your journey into a connected story of events, not just a list. Our standout feature ? The ability to share your entire trip's timeline. It’s your journey, documented and ready to be shared anywhere, preserving your memories in a unique, visual format.

records.name: Ai Song Maker
records.tagline: AI Song Maker is a powerful, no-code AI music generator
records.description: AI Song Maker is a next-generation AI-powered music creation platform that turns anyone into a songwriter in seconds—no instruments, skills, or studio required. Launched for 2025’s creator economy, this SaaS tool uses cutting-edge generative AI to transform text prompts like “energetic EDM track about chasing dreams” or “sad acoustic ballad in Spanish” into complete, studio-quality songs with vocals, lyrics, melody, and instrumentation.

records.name: Elmmetric
records.tagline: AI invoice processing that saves 12+ hours per week
records.description: Elmmetric: Innovative sElmmetric transforms invoice and accounting workflows into an automated, AI-powered experience. From invoice capture to approval and payment, Elmmetric handles it all—extracting data, matching receipts, routing approvals, and syncing with your ledger in real-time. Transparent, audit-ready, and built for teams who want fewer spreadsheets and more insight. Empower your finance team with clarity, speed, and smarter automation. solutions for modern businesses.

records.name: VTodo
records.tagline: Visualized Todo Manager for Vibe Coding
records.description: A visual kanban board and CLI tool for managing project todo. Perfect for vibe coding workflows! V for Vibecoding and Visualized. VTodo is designed to work seamlessly with AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI-powered editors. By integrating vtodo into your AI workflow, you can maintain clear project context and track implementation progress automatically.

records.name: BackMark
records.tagline: Markdown-Native Task Management for AI-Powered Vibe Coding
records.description: BackMark transforms plain Markdown files into a powerful task management system designed specifically for "vibe coding" - seamless human-AI collaboration. Unlike traditional tools, BackMark treats AI as a first-class team member with dedicated spaces for planning, documentation, and self-review. Every task is stored as a simplemd file with YAML frontmatter - future-proof, Git-friendly, and completely portable. No databases, no cloud, no vendor lock-in.

records.name: Your Shoe Smells-Map for stinky gyms
records.tagline: Crowdsourced website for rating bouldering gym's smelliness
records.description: Find and rate the climbing/bouldering gyms nearby. Discover gyms, vote on smelliness, difficulty, parking, utility, and more. You can ask: "Which gym is the most smelly one?", "Where is the hardest gym?", or "Is there a moonboard/Kilterboard?", "Is there a sauna in this place?" You will get: An interactive climbing map tailored for you!

records.name: WordFlippin
records.tagline: Flip new words into lasting knowledge daily!!!
records.description: Master vocabulary with AI-powered spaced repetition. WordFlippin uses science-backed learning techniques to ensure every new word sticks permanently. Learn smarter, remember longer, and expand your vocab with confidence. Your words. Your pace. Real results.

records.name: Noro ADHD Planner
records.tagline: Turn a braindump and wordvomit into a structured plan
records.description: Noro is the AI-powered ADHD planner that turns messy voice dumps into clean, structured todos with automatic time estimates and subtasks. Built for neurodivergent minds that struggle with time blindness and task initiation, and follow-through.

records.name: The Map of Human Ideas
records.tagline: Discover where the world’s greatest ideas were born
records.description: Ever wondered where the world’s biggest ideas came from? The Map of Human Ideas visualizes over 250 discoveries, philosophies, and inventions across centuries. Each point on the map marks the origin of an idea that changed our collective story. Built as a side project to celebrate curiosity and creativity.

records.name: Chatter
records.tagline: Discover which reddit investors make it big — and how often
records.description: Search any stock ticker and discover what Reddit is saying. See which redditors get it right — and how often. Keep track of the posts you like the most and view their performance over time. Currently using data from r/wallstreetbets only, but planning to increase data sources in the future. Completely free to use!

records.name: Listentus
records.tagline: AI powered Listening exercises & Exams for 27 languages
records.description: Listentus gives you three simple areas: a dashboard that shows score progress, an AI based generator that makes exams, and a practice lab for quick drills. Everything is built for students who want steady listening practice for school success.

records.description: Find unique, meaningful names tailored to your family story. Our free AI-powered generator combines your preferences, cultural background, and family traditions to create beautiful name suggestions.
